scope: Greeting extension only. Existing controller and inference contracts are unchanged.
behavior: A deterministic fixed greeting tool gated by a completed authorized controller request. The greeting is a tool response and is not described as model-generated text.
procedure: Read final isolated compiler input and build; verify exact source hashes and compiler settings.
Recompile that exact input and require ABI, creation bytecode and runtime bytecode to match every extension build artifact.
Wait for the root agent to confirm extension deployment address, successful creation transaction, and prior publication of source and compiler input in the public GitHub repository.
Read the public GitHub sources/compiler input and prove that the source contents and settings exactly match the reproduced build.
Encode the constructor arguments from the confirmed extension deployment journal and require its creation-code hash to match the journal.
Submit only already-public compiler input and public creation metadata to the independent Sourcify v2 verification API.
Poll the returned verification ID in bounded requests; record exact matches or the actual pending/failure status.
networkScope: Sourcify public source verification and read-only public GitHub provenance only. No wallet access, signing, transaction broadcasts, chain RPC, or GitHub modifications.
